excluded_with_reason.META: Cheap at PE 23 but -18.6 blended relative momentum. Waiting for the downtrend to break before paying for the value.
excluded_with_reason.AVGO: -22.5pp relative over 3m at PE 46. Poor momentum/valuation combination.
excluded_with_reason.COST: PE 46 with negative momentum on both horizons.
excluded_with_reason.TSLA: PE 329. Valuation is not defensible under this mandate.
excluded_with_reason.NFLX: 62% of its 52-week high and in a sustained downtrend.
